metadata.question: Does surface water extent in Death Valley National Park increase in August 7, 2022 compared to July 11, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- AOI: Try WDPA polygon for "Death Valley" with DESIG_ENG="National Park"; fallback to a bounding rectangle if WDPA not available.
- Collections: Prefer Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED). If none, widen window (±3 days). If still none, fallback to Landsat 9/8 L2 merged, with same widening rule.
- Dates: Exact windows [2022-07-11, 2022-07-12) and [2022-08-07, 2022-08-08). Only widen if empty.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Yes, mask clouds to measure surface water. S2: QA60 bits 10/11 for clouds/cirrus. Landsat: QA_PIXEL bits for cloud/shadow/snow.
- Use MNDWI (Green vs SWIR1). Threshold > 0.2 as water. Compute valid area (post-mask), coverage area (pre-mask), cloud% = 1 - valid/coverage.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection empty after fallback: C1.
- If valid area is 0 (but coverage > 0): C2.
- If any numeric is null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare water areas. If Aug > Jul by > 0.01 km²: A; else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const dateJul = '2022-07-11';
    const dateAug = '2022-08-07';
    const oneDay = 1;
    const widenDays = 3; // widen window if empty
    const scale = 1000; // per requirement
    const maxPixels = 1e9;
    const waterThresh = 0.2;

    function toDateRange(dateStr, widen) {
      const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
      return widen
        ? [d.advance(-widen, 'day'), d.advance(widen + 1, 'day')]
        : [d, d.advance(oneDay, 'day')];
    }

    // AOI: Try WDPA, fallback to rectangle
    function getAOI() {
      let aoiSource = 'WDPA';
      let fc = ee.FeatureCollection('WCMC/WDPA/current/polygons')
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('DESIG_ENG', 'National Park'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('NAME', 'Death Valley'));
      const count = fc.size();
      const aoi = ee.Algorithms.If(
        count.gt(0),
        ee.Feature(fc.union(1).first()).geometry(),
        ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-118.2, 35.6, -115.9, 37.4], null, false)
      );
      return { aoi: ee.Geometry(aoi), source: aoiSource, wdpaCount: count };
    }

    const aoiInfo = getAOI();
    const aoi = aoiInfo.aoi;
    const wdpaCount = await aoiInfo.wdpaCount.getInfo();
    const aoiSource = wdpaCount > 0 ? 'WDPA' : 'Rect';
    const aoiArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('area').getInfo();
    console.log(`AOI Source: ${aoiSource}, Area_km2: ${(aoiArea/1e6).toFixed(1)}`);

    // Utility: Check numeric validity
    function validNumber(x) {
      return x !== null && x !== undefined && !isNaN(x) && isFinite(x);
    }

    // Sentinel-2 helpers
    function maskS2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0);
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0);
      return img.updateMask(cloud.and(cirrus));
    }
    function addMNDWI_S2(img) {
      const green = img.select('B3');
      const swir1 = img.select('B11');
      const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI');
      return img.addBands(mndwi);
    }

    // Landsat helpers
    function scaleL2(img) {
      // USGS L2 scale factors
      const refl = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const out = img.addBands(refl, null, true);
      return out;
    }
    function maskLandsat(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0);
      const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0);
      const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0);
      return img.updateMask(cloud.and(shadow).and(snow));
    }
    function addMNDWI_LS(img) {
      const green = img.select('SR_B3');
      const swir1 = img.select('SR_B6');
      const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI');
      return img.addBands(mndwi);
    }

    async function analyzeDate(dateStr, label) {
      // Try S2 exact day
      let [s, e] = toDateRange(dateStr, false);
      let s2col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterDate(s, e)
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90));
      let s2Count = await s2col.size().getInfo();

      let widened = false;
      if (s2Count === 0) {
        // widen window
        widened = true;
        [s, e] = toDateRange(dateStr, widenDays);
        s2col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
          .filterDate(s, e)
          .filterBounds(aoi)
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90));
        s2Count = await s2col.size().getInfo();
      }

      let source = 'S2';
      let colUsed = null;
      let countUsed = s2Count;

      if (s2Count > 0) {
        colUsed = s2col.map(maskS2).map(addMNDWI_S2);
      } else {
        // Fallback to Landsat 9 + 8
        source = 'Landsat';
        let [lsS, lsE] = toDateRange(dateStr, false);
        let l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(lsS, lsE).filterBounds(aoi);
        let l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(lsS, lsE).filterBounds(aoi);
        let lsCol = l9.merge(l8);
        let lsCount = await lsCol.size().getInfo();
        if (lsCount === 0) {
          // widen for Landsat
          [lsS, lsE] = toDateRange(dateStr, widenDays);
          l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(lsS, lsE).filterBounds(aoi);
          l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(lsS, lsE).filterBounds(aoi);
          lsCol = l9.merge(l8);
          lsCount = await lsCol.size().getInfo();
        }
        countUsed = lsCount;
        if (lsCount === 0) {
          return { status: 'C1', msg: `${label} Images: 0 (S2 & LS)` };
        }
        colUsed = lsCol.map(scaleL2).map(maskLandsat).map(addMNDWI_LS);
      }

      // Coverage (pre-mask) from green band proxy
      let preCol = (source === 'S2')
        ? ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED').filterDate(s, e).filterBounds(aoi)
        : ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(s, e).filterBounds(aoi)
            .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(s, e).filterBounds(aoi)).map(scaleL2);

      let greenBand = (source === 'S2') ? 'B3' : 'SR_B3';
      let preImage = preCol.select(greenBand).median();
      let coverageArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(preImage.mask()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area').getInfo();

      // Valid mask and MNDWI median
      const mndwiMed = colUsed.select('MNDWI').median();

      let validArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(mndwiMed.mask()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area').getInfo();

      if (!validNumber(coverageArea) || !validNumber(validArea)) {
        return { status: 'C3', msg: `${label} Calculation invalid.` };
      }
      if (coverageArea <= 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', msg: `${label} Coverage_km2: 0` };
      }
      const cloudPct = 100 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (validArea / coverageArea)));

      // Water area
      const waterMask = mndwiMed.gt(waterThresh);
      let waterArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area').getInfo();

      if (!validNumber(waterArea)) {
        return { status: 'C3', msg: `${label} Water calc invalid.` };
      }

      if (validArea <= 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', msg: `${label} Valid_km2: 0` };
      }

      const dateNote = widened ? '±3d' : 'exact';
      const summary = `${label} ${dateNote} | Src:${source} Img:${countUsed} Cov_km2:${(coverageArea/1e6).toFixed(1)} Valid_km2:${(validArea/1e6).toFixed(1)} Cloud%:${cloudPct.toFixed(1)} Water_km2:${(waterArea/1e6).toFixed(2)}`;
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        source,
        count: countUsed,
        coverageArea,
        validArea,
        cloudPct,
        waterArea,
        summary
      };
    }

    // 2-4. Run analyses and compute
    const resJul = await analyzeDate(dateJul, '2022-07-11');
    if (resJul.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(resJul.msg || `2022-07-11 Status: ${resJul.status}`);
      console.log(resJul.status);
      return;
    }
    console.log(resJul.summary);

    const resAug = await analyzeDate(dateAug, '2022-08-07');
    if (resAug.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(resAug.msg || `2022-08-07 Status: ${resAug.status}`);
      console.log(resAug.status);
      return;
    }
    console.log(resAug.summary);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const wJul = resJul.waterArea / 1e6; // km2
    const wAug = resAug.waterArea / 1e6; // km2
    const delta = wAug - wJul;
    console.log(`Delta_Water_km2 (Aug - Jul): ${delta.toFixed(2)}`);

    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const increased = delta > 0.01; // 0.01 km² threshold
    console.log(increased ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
  } catch (err) {
    // Likely D (dataset/band/method issues) or other runtime errors
    const msg = (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err);
    const short = msg.length > 140 ? msg.substring(0, 140) + '...' : msg;
    console.log(`Error: ${short}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
